title: Ranch/Property Film Estimate

deliverables.title: Ranch Property Film (Lean Production)
deliverables.description: A story-driven ranch film shot by one operator.

lineItems.details: Landscape, ranch operations, structures and water, with drone coverage of the full property. Includes pre-production planning and a shot list. One day covers most properties. Larger properties can add days.
Owner or steward interview, either sit-down with professional lighting and audio or a follow-along walkthrough on a gimbal.
Story development and edit of a 2-4 minute film, with color grading and sound design.
Intro/outro titles with the property name and your logo, lower thirds, and a satellite map animation showing boundaries, acreage, key features and proximity to nearby draws.
Find, license and add royalty free background music that fits the property. Cleared for all uses.
30-second vertical cut optimized for social media.

deliverablesList: Full usage rights on delivery, no licensing fees

milestones.milestone: Discovery call, creative approach and shot list
Property access, coordination and introductions with relevant parties
Final film and social cut delivered

deliverables.title: Travel to California (Estimated, Billed at Cost)
deliverables.description: Billed at actual cost. Final number set once the property and dates are confirmed.

lineItems.details: Round trip from Bozeman, including checked camera and drone cases.
Three-day rental with clearance for ranch roads.

nextSteps.heading: Next Steps
nextSteps.text: If you'd like to learn more, grab any open time on my calendar and we'll talk through your properties and what you need.

referencesSubtitle: Two films worth a look, one on an Idaho ranch and one in Montana. Someday Ranch leans on aerials and animated maps to show the property's scale and the selling points buyers care about. From Farmland to Grassland takes a more human approach, built around an interview with the people who work the land.
